The Board of Directors

Subject: Resignation

The undersigned hereby tenders his irrevocable resignation with immediate effect as the Nominee
Director of AASH Projects (Private) Limited on the board of Delta Centauri Developments
(Private) Limited (“Company”).
It is requested that the resignation be accepted as aforesaid accordingly and intimated to the
Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan.
The undersigned hereby acknowledges and confirms unconditionally and irrevocably that he has
no claims of any nature whatsoever against the Company in his capacity as the Nominee Director
of AASH Projects (Private) Limited or any other capacity.

Sincerely,
